params.body:
The preview has existed since 16 September and the README still described a single environment and a
staging that does not exist.

**Environments** now carries both Forge sites, with what the preview actually is: one pull request at
a time on last night's copy of production, on the fixed branch `preview`, put there by the control
gateway rather than by a key on a laptop. Plus why it exists at all — a screen you have to judge is
worth nothing on invented data, and on production it is already merged — and why its seal is not a
convenience but the thing that makes the copy safe to hold: it carries the real addresses of 542
dealers and the Car-Pass and Modix credentials of 393 of them, and `stocklist:preview-refresh`
refuses to run unless the seal is closed.

Four other things had gone stale in the same weeks, all of them actively misleading to read:

- "There is no Pint or PHPStan configuration in the repo. Code style is handled by StyleCI." There is
  now Pint, Larastan at level 5 with a baseline, and ESLint with a warning ceiling; StyleCI stopped
  reporting somewhere before the takeover.
- The CI was described as two jobs. It is seven, spread over pull request and main because a run
  costs eleven billed minutes, and a superseded push is cancelled.
- The mail redirect was described as "whenever `APP_DEBUG` is true". It hangs on `MAIL_ALWAYS_TO`
  now, and the line says what that means for production, because the failure mode is silent.
- The schema date to move when the dump is regenerated is in `ParallelTests::SCHEMA_DUMP_DATE`, not
  in the workflow.

And one addition next to the routes Elixir reads: **Beheer > Werking**, because it answers the same
question from the inside.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
params.title: The README says what is true again
